name: MCP Apps
description: Cards for AI apps that draw MCP Apps (claude.ai, ChatGPT): a note read is drawn with Open in Vaultite, a task list ticks in place, a Kanban board moves its cards. The same cards draw in your notes, with a block naming a tool.
forAgents: A tool's card in a note: ```block-mcp-app with `tool:` (one that reads, like tasks_list) and `arguments:` (`vau docs mcp-apps`).

mcp-app.description: an MCP tool's card (MCP Apps), drawn as AI apps draw it: the tool runs when the note is shown, and the card can act (tick a task, move a card)

tool.description: the tool, by its MCP name (tasks_list, kanban_read, read): one that only reads

arguments.description: its arguments, as its schema names them (query: not done)

height.description: a fixed height in pixels; otherwise as tall as the card
